summary: Your notes can now train Northwind's AI unless you opt out, price rises need only 7 days' notice, deleted data stays 180 days, and disputes go to private arbitration.

changes.title: Your notes can be used to train AI
changes.what: Northwind can now use your content to train its AI models unless you opt out in Settings.
changes.before: We use Your Content only to provide and improve the service for you.
changes.after: including to train and improve our AI models, unless you opt out in Settings

changes.title: Courts replaced by private arbitration
changes.what: Disputes no longer go to the Dublin courts: they go to binding individual arbitration, and you give up class actions.
changes.before: Any dispute will be heard by the courts of Dublin.
changes.after: Any dispute will be resolved by binding individual arbitration, and you waive any right to take part in a class action.

changes.title: Less notice before price rises
changes.what: Notice before a price change drops from 30 days to 7.

changes.title: Your data is kept longer after you leave
changes.what: After your account ends, your content is deleted within 180 days instead of 30.
changes.before: we delete Your Content within 30 days
changes.after: we delete Your Content within 180 days

changes.title: New cancellation fee
changes.after: You can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the paid period.

minor.why: New office address; the contact email is unchanged.
